dimensions.name: Question Quality
dimensions.pass_criteria: Every question represents a genuine challenge a skeptical customer would raise about risk, cost, workflow change, data, competition, or failure modes.
dimensions.fail_criteria: Questions are softballs or leading questions that assume a positive answer. The set feels like a marketing FAQ rather than skeptical customer scrutiny.

dimensions.name: Answer Completeness
dimensions.pass_criteria: Every question has either a substantive answer or is explicitly marked [OPEN - owner: X] with a named owner.
dimensions.fail_criteria: One or more questions have no answer, are not marked [OPEN], or are marked open without a named owner.

dimensions.name: No Evasive Answers
dimensions.pass_criteria: Each answer directly resolves the question asked. Genuine uncertainty is marked [OPEN] rather than dressed up as an answer.
dimensions.fail_criteria: One or more answers restate the question, deflect to vague future plans, or use marketing language to avoid a hard truth.

dimensions.name: Coverage of Critical Concerns
dimensions.pass_criteria: The FAQ covers customer concerns most likely to block adoption: data/privacy, workflow change, cost/value, failure modes, and differentiation from alternatives.
dimensions.fail_criteria: The FAQ is missing one or more critical concern categories that a reasonable customer in the target segment would raise.
